purpose: Teach: 奴ら/巷/傍ら/導き/綴っ/無けれ/しかり/情景

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達を「奴ら」って呼ぶのは失礼よ
lines.en: Sho, it's disrespectful to call your friends that.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not scolding. Warm but steady. A moment of pause before the redirect, like she's choosing her words carefully for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、巷で人気のお菓子買ってきてくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, you brought home that snack everyone's been talking about!
lines.style: Bright recognition, quick tempo. Eyes light up on the reveal. Pure delight without performance—a six-year-old genuinely excited about something small and specific.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが翔くんの傍らで宿題を見て下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad sat with you while you did your homework today.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. Noticing something tender that happened. Quiet warmth—not drawing attention to the moment, just holding it gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの導きで頑張れるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can keep trying when you guide me like this.
lines.style: Earnest and reaching. Small voice but certain. The kind of statement a child makes when he means it completely—no performance, just truth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家族のお話を綴って下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been writing down the family's stories.
lines.style: Reverent, almost hushed. Speaking about something precious. Slow pace, breathing space between phrases. The voice of someone witnessing something worth honoring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが無ければお家が寂しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the house would feel so empty without Dad.
lines.style: Vulnerable, matter-of-fact. Not seeking comfort but stating what's true. Small voice, steady—the honesty of a child who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお話もしかり、心に響くわね
lines.en: Sho, the things your dad tells us—they really do touch the heart.
lines.style: Thoughtful, moved. Slight breath before speaking, like the realization is settling in as she says it. Tender but grounded, not overstated.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夕暮れの情景が好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love how it feels at dusk.
lines.style: Quiet and reflective. Hesitant, like he's sharing something delicate. Slow, almost dreamlike pace. Trailing off gently, as if he's still seeing what he's describing.
